For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Rakesh Kumar  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Yogendra Kumar Singh  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 2 15-07-2024 This is an application for quashing the F.I.R. of Turjauliya P.S. Case No. 137 of 2023 registered for the offences under Sections 370, 371(A), 371, 372, 373, 376(C )/34 of the I.P.C., under Section 75&
76 of the J.J. Act and under Section 4/6 of the POCSO Act.
2. The petitioner relies upon his defence brought on affidavit.

3. In view of the law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of State of Bihar V/s P.P.
Sharma reported in 1992 Supp (1) SCC 222, this application cannot be considered at this stage and the F.I.R. cannot be quashed by seeing the affidavit evidence and the defence of the O.P. No. 02.
4.
